title: aidd doctor --json
description: What `aidd doctor --json` prints: each check of the repository's wiring, whether any has the result `error`, and a finding for each check that has the result `error` or `warning`.

schema_version.description: The version of this output's shape. A new key keeps it; a renamed, removed, or retyped key bumps it.

passed.description: True when no check has the result `error`: the exit code is 0. A warning never makes it false.

checks.description: Each check, in the order the text output prints them.

result.description: error (the exit code is 1), warning (worth fixing), or note (never a finding). A check that passed has no result.

message.description: What the check found, with the next step when it has a result.

findings.description: One finding for each check with the result `error` or `warning`, in the order of `checks`, with the message the check gives. A check that passed, or has the result `note`, is no finding.
